text_en: After a while, at the time of the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife, bringing along a kid. He said, “I want to go into my wife’s room. ” But her father would not allow him to go in.
text_cn: 过了一些日子，正是收割麦子的时期，三松带了一只小山羊去看他的妻子；他说：“我要到内室去亲近我的妻子。”但是妻子的父亲不让他进去，

text_en: Her father said, “I was sure that you had rejected her; so I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister prettier than she? Why not take her instead? ”
text_cn: 且说：“我以为你一定厌恶了她，所以我将她嫁给你的一个同伴；她的妹妹不是比她更美吗？你可娶而代之。”

text_en: Samson said to them, “This time, when I do mischief to the Philistines, I will be without blame. ”
text_cn: 三松对他们说：“我若加害培肋舍特人，这一次我可不负责。”

text_en: So Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took some torches; and he turned the foxes tail to tail, and put a torch between each pair of tails.
text_cn: 于是三松去捉了三百只狐狸，又拿火把来，把狐狸的尾和尾结在一起，将火把插在二尾中间，

text_en: When he had set fire to the torches, he let the foxes go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up the shocks and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
text_cn: 点着火把，将狐狸放入培肋舍特人的庄田内，把堆集的麦捆，立着的庄稼，葡萄园和橄榄园都烧了。

text_en: Then the Philistines asked, “Who has done this? ” And they said, “Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken Samson’s wife and given her to his companion. ” So the Philistines came up, and burned her and her father.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人问说：“是谁作了这事？”有人说：“是提默纳人的女婿三松，因为他的岳父把他的妻子嫁给了他的一个同伴。”培肋舍特人就上去，放火烧了那女子和她的父家。

text_en: Samson said to them, “If this is what you do, I swear I will not stop until I have taken revenge on you. ”
text_cn: 三松向他们说：“你们既然这样作，我必向你们复仇，然后才罢休。”

text_en: He struck them down hip and thigh with great slaughter; and he went down and stayed in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
text_cn: 三松遂打击他们，腿腰乱砍，大杀一阵；然后下去住在厄坦的一个石穴内。

text_en: Then the Philistines came up and encamped in Judah, and made a raid on Lehi.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人上去，在犹大扎营，进袭肋希。

text_en: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us? ” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he did to us. ”
text_cn: 犹大人问说：“你们为什么上来攻打我们？他们答说：“我们上来是为拘捕三松，要报复他对我们所行的。”

text_en: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam, and they said to Samson, “Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then have you done to us? ” He replied, “As they did to me, so I have done to them. ”
text_cn: 于是有三千犹大人到厄坦石穴那里，对三松说：“难道你不知道培肋舍特人统治我们吗？你为什么作连累我们的事？”他回答说：“他们怎样待我，我也怎样待他们。”

text_en: They said to him, “We have come down to bind you, so that we may give you into the hands of the Philistines. ” Samson answered them, “Swear to me that you yourselves will not attack me. ”
text_cn: 他们就向他说：“我们下来是为拘捕你，把你交在培肋舍特人手中。”三松向他们说：“你们要对我发誓，不杀害我！”

text_en: They said to him, “No, we will only bind you and give you into their hands; we will not kill you. ” So they bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.
text_cn: 他们回答说：“一定不；我们只把你绑好，交在他们手中，决不杀你。”他们于是用两条新绳把他捆起，从石穴里把他拉上来。

text_en: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him; and the spirit of the Lord rushed on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became like flax that has caught fire, and his bonds melted off his hands.
text_cn: 他来到肋希，培肋舍特人呐喊着出来迎他；那时上主的神突然降在他身上，他手臂上的绳索，好像着火的细麻一样，绑他的绳子从他的手上落下。

text_en: Then he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached down and took it, and with it he killed a thousand men.
text_cn: 他找到一块鲜驴腮骨，伸手拿起来，击杀了一千人。

text_en: And Samson said, “With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps upon heaps, with the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men. ”
text_cn: 然后三松喊说：“用驴腮骨杀的一堆一堆，用驴腮骨杀了一千。”

text_en: When he had finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and that place was called Ramath-lehi.
text_cn: 当他说完这话，就顺手把腮骨抛弃了；因此那地名叫辣玛肋希。

text_en: By then he was very thirsty, and he called on the Lord , saying, “You have granted this great victory by the hand of your servant. Am I now to die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised? ”
text_cn: 此后，他非常口渴，呼吁上主说：“你藉你仆人的手得了这次大胜利；如今我却要渴死，陷于这些没有割损的人手中。”

text_en: So God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came from it. When he drank, his spirit returned, and he revived. Therefore it was named En-hakkore, which is at Lehi to this day.
text_cn: 天主遂在肋希使一洼地裂开，涌出水来；他喝了水，精神恢复，无异再生；因此那泉称作“呼吁泉”，至今还在肋希。

text_en: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
text_cn: 他在培肋舍特人统治以色列的时日内，作以色列民长二十年。
